description.value: Coffee + Vanilla is a neighbourhood café in Austin Heights, Coquitlam, operated by owners Sarah and Joe, who specialize in handcrafted specialty coffee and freshly made pastries and desserts. The menu spans croissant sandwiches, panini, French macarons, butter pecan tarts, and Belgian sugar waffles — all made fresh daily. Online ordering with free pickup is available, making it a practical refreshment stop on a ride through the Tri-Cities area.

The website confirms pickup/takeout ordering but does not mention bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi (despite the OSM internet_access=wlan tag, which cannot be treated as authoritative per rules).
